categories_thin: Optometry was re-run in this revision: only two additional independent Edison optometrists could be confirmed with an address (Dogan, Hertz/Wosk). Healthgrades' Edison optometry directory names about nineteen providers but carries no addresses, so most could not be proven to sit in Edison and were left out rather than guessed.

Psychotherapy / counseling remains undercounted: most Edison solo LPC/LCSW practices advertise only through Psychology Today, NPI records or telehealth sites, and several listings point to residential addresses, which were deliberately not recorded.

Home health and home-care agencies in Edison (e.g. agencies listed at 485 US-1, 505 Thornall St and 105 Fieldcrest Ave) appear only in state and insurer PDF directories that could not be opened and read here, so they were not listed.
Nail and hair salons: another pass added a few, but many small Edison storefront salons exist only on booking platforms and Google Maps, which were not opened in a browser this round.
caveats: Many entries are recorded from a single bulk directory (marked 'one directory only') and need triage confirmation before outreach.
More than forty entries are solo practitioners or single-chair studios rather than multi-staff businesses; they are included because they are independent local businesses.

Revision: all entries taken from a med-spa aggregator's 'Edison' page that proved to be in Scotch Plains, South Plainfield, Staten Island, Highland Park, East Brunswick, Warren or Metuchen were deleted, along with Oak Tree Animal Clinic (South Plainfield), Anara Medspa (moved to East Brunswick), Lash Lab Express (Parlin), Forever Young Complete Healthcare (Piscataway/Iselin), Jenna Dziedzic LPC (Metuchen) and the Center for Anxiety and Life Management (Iselin).

Revision: Beam Dental Edison was removed as a multi-site dental group; duplicate records were merged (Panchal/Moses; Perfect Dental Smile/DeMatteis) and the Gina Hering injector listing was folded into It Aesthetix.

Revision: every remaining entry carries a street address taken from the business's own site or a specific listing (mobile vet and mall-based massage excepted); four addresses (Bright Medical Aesthetics, Aesthetic Clinic De Charme, La Belle Nail, Healing Joints) came from search listings rather than a page opened directly, and are flagged in their notes.
Multiple practices share medical-suite addresses (e.g. 2163 Oak Tree Rd, 976 Inman Ave, 4 Ethel Rd); these are separate businesses in the same building, not duplicates.
Excluded as chains/franchises: Visionworks, America's Best, Aspen Dental, Diamond Braces, Banfield, LaserAway, Thriveworks Counseling and the large gym franchises.
data_gaps: Overpass API / OpenStreetMap was not used.
Google Maps and Bing Maps were not opened in a browser; map-level completeness for small salons and studios is unverified.
NJ Division of Consumer Affairs licence lookups were not queried, so licence status and active/inactive standing are unconfirmed.

Several practice sites blocked automated fetching (healingjoints.com, premiercaretherapy.com, c2medspanj.com, edisoneyecarenj.com, bbb.org), so their details rest on search-returned listings rather than a page read directly.
Home health/hospice agencies and Psychology Today-only counselors were not enumerable from accessible public pages.
